title: DFN: Resin Equipment
description: This Mod adds a Craftable Resin Sword and Tools!
body:
## Resin Tools

Put your resin to work.

This mod adds a full set of resin tools, giving you a simple and useful upgrade path using a resource that often goes unused. Resin tools are slightly better than iron, making them a solid mid-game option without changing the core Minecraft feel.

### 🔶 What’s Included

*   Resin Sword
*   Resin Pickaxe
*   Resin Axe
*   Resin Shovel
*   Resin Hoe

### ⚙️ Key Traits

*   **Balanced stats** – A bit better than Gold Tools
*   **Reliable durability** - 74 Uses
*   **Easy crafting** – uses Resin like a standard material
*   **Higher Enchantability** - Resin Tools have a higher Enchantability than other tools

### 🎯 Design Philosophy

Resin tools are designed to feel **natural and straightforward**. No gimmicks, just a clean extension of vanilla progression.

### 🔧 Vanilla-Friendly

*   Simple recipes
*   No extra systems or mechanics
*   Fits right into your world

**A small addition that makes resin finally useful!**
